name: Emily Carey
biography: Emily Joanna Carey (born 30 April 2003) is an English actress. She began her career as a child actor on stage and in the BBC One soap opera Casualty (2014–2017, 2021). She went on to play young versions of characters, such as Diana Prince in Wonder Woman (2017), Lara Croft in Tomb Raider (2018), and young Alicent Hightower in the HBO fantasy series House of the Dragon (2022). She also appeared in BBC iPlayer teen series Get Even (2020). Carey uses both she/her and they/them pronouns.
